registrationDescription: Control account creation and initial permissions for new users.
allowRegistrationDescription: Show registration on the login page; when disabled, only administrators can create users.
defaultRoleDescription: Applied to self-registered accounts. The administrator role cannot be assigned here.
googleDescription: Configure EasySSH as a Google OAuth client for third-party sign-in.
googleEnabledDescription: This is a way to sign in to EasySSH and is independent from EasySSH acting as an OAuth provider.
googleClientSecretDescription: The credential is encrypted at rest. Leave empty to keep the saved secret.
secretConfigured: A secret is configured. Leave empty to keep it unchanged.
googleCallback: Configure this callback in Google Cloud Console: {url}
loginSessionDescription: Manage login persistence independently from browser cross-origin policy.
sessionTimeoutDescription: End the login session after there is no interaction on any page.
rememberLoginDescription: Use a persistent refresh-token cookie when selected; otherwise it lasts for the browser session.
loginProtectionDescription: Manage login, API, and 2FA limits plus breached-password checks.
pwnedCheckDescription: Queries Have I Been Pwned using a k-anonymity prefix. Service outages do not block registration or password changes.
providerDescription: Disabled by default. Configure only when another system needs EasySSH as its authorization server.
providerEnabled: Allow other sites to authorize through EasySSH
providerEnabledDescription: Expose standard authorization, discovery, JWKS, UserInfo, revocation, and introspection endpoints.
providerRedirectUrisDescription: One absolute URL per line. Production values must all use HTTPS.
providerRestartNotice: Restart after first configuring or changing public URLs. The switch becomes available after startup validation; EasySSH's own login never depends on these URLs.
providerIssuerWarning: The issuer is the trust anchor for external tokens. Changing it can invalidate existing client trust and issued tokens, so use a maintenance window.
